objective: Add the earned-budget rule to SLOW-LOOP's slow loop, tune it on rand, block and local window 10 at n = 800 (E) and on rand and block alone (Erb), and test with five runs per instance on seven patterns at n = 3200 against re-tuned Novelty+ and probSAT, tuned static probing, the best fixed budget on the same mixture (Gm) and SLOW-LOOP's G and GO.
status: Reading 2 by the frozen rule (it works, but earning is not shown to matter): the earned budget E, tuned on rand, block and local w10 at n = 800, has charged wins on the never-run primary local w15 d3.5 (0.56 [0.51, 0.68], CPU 0.61), local w20 (0.75) and local w10 (0.56) at 3200, costs 3% on every structure-poor pattern and beats the best fixed batched budget; it fails E/GO <= 1.5 on local w10 (1.65), leaves a 3.4-4.1x regret against the per-cell fixed oracle (0.16-0.18), never leaves its floor on local w40, and tuned without a local pattern (Erb) it does not carry over. Computed, stress test pending (12800), referee pending.
title: A productivity-driven slow budget for the structure-changing slow loop, tested on fresh instances and new meeting patterns
